title: Canonical field and integral Frobenius purity comparison data
statement:
Fix a purity datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], with finite field $k_0$, fixed algebraic closure $k$, prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$, finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside the fixed coefficient closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a separated finite-type morphism, and $X,Y,f$ their geometric base changes. Let $g_X,g_Y$ and $P_X=Lg_X^*,P_Y=Lg_Y^*$ be the geometric-Frobenius maps and their pullbacks of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. Use the actual rational and common-stage categories of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Fix a compactification $c_0$ of $f_0$, its base change $c$ of [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and a coefficient-normalized constructible adjunction system $S$ of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

For $\Lambda=E$ or $\Omega$ and $d\in\mathbf N$, define $H_\Lambda(K)=\Lambda_X(d)[2d]\otimes^L Lf^*K$ using precisely the source functors and shifted lines of [def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports]. Define $b_K:P_XH_\Lambda K\xrightarrow{\sim}H_\Lambda P_YK$ by the canonical tensor-pullback map, the shift comparison, the root-normalized Tate-line map of [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists], and the pullback-composition square for $g_X\,;f=f\,;g_Y$. In the common-stage case the shifted-line map is represented at the least finite coefficient field with its specified stage pullback comparison, and the pullback square is the actual common-stage square of [def-zl-field-weil-shriek-shift-data].

Define also the completed integral Frobenius pullback $P_T^{\mathrm{int}}$ on the integral constructible category of [def-pur-conventions]. Its compact-support comparison $\beta_M^{\mathrm{int}}:P_Y^{\mathrm{int}}F^{\mathrm{int}}M\xrightarrow{\sim}F^{\mathrm{int}}P_X^{\mathrm{int}}M$ is the composite of completed-to-ordinary Frobenius comparison, inverse compact-support realization, the actual ordinary proper/open Frobenius exchange of [def-zl-frobenius-compact-support-comparison], inverse completed-to-ordinary comparison on $M$, and compact-support realization on $P_X^{\mathrm{int}}M$, with the realization of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. For rational coefficients localize this integral comparison and conjugate by the specified comparison between $S$'s left functor and compact support to define $\beta^E:P_YF_E\xrightarrow{\sim}F_EP_X$. For common-stage coefficients define $\beta^\Omega$ by representing each object at its literal finite coefficient stage, using $\beta^E$ there, and composing with the specified stage pullback and compact-support comparison components in their actual order. These are the compact-support transports of [def-pur-compact-support-transport].

When $f$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], define $\Gamma^E_K$ and $\Gamma^\Omega_K$ to be exactly the isomorphisms of [def-pur-canonical-rational-purity-realization] specialized to $f,c,S$, with the inherited prime inverses and geometric-fibre over-structures supplied. The definitions introduce no Weil datum on an integral lattice and no naturality, mate or equivariance assertion.
